dialogue.context: Existing dialogue. Ordinary conversation beside Sella.
dialogue.text:
Pell: Sella makes me undo a knot if I cannot explain what holds it.
Pell: I thought she was being cruel. Then a man stood on my first net.

description: Sella’s apprentice once thought it cruel to be made to undo a knot he could not explain. Seeing a man stand on his first net made the demand understandable. The lesson ties a small hand skill to somebody else’s safety; no larger guild or training institution is established.
